## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Mogharājamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 19), rendered in English as the "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Mogharāja", is a canonical commentary forming part of the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. In the available secondary literature dossier, the work is not subject to substantive independent analysis, appearing solely in bibliographies and footnote references pointing to online tipitaka editions [Ponampon 2018; Ponampon 2019].
Curated passage-level parallels identified by SuttaCentral connect the text to several treatises in the *Mahāniddesa* (such as the *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa*, *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa*, and *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa*), other sections of the *Cūḷaniddesa* (including the *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa*, *Upasīvamāṇavapucchāniddesa*, and *Dhotakamāṇavapucchāniddesa*), and the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (*Indriyakathā* and *Ñāṇakathā*) [SuttaCentral]. Cross-references and shared verses are also noted with Dhammapada traditions (Dhp 170, Patna Dharmapada, Gāndhārī Dharmapada, and Udānavarga), canonical discourses (DN 14, SN 12.37, SN 22.33, SN 35.246, Iti 38), and later works including the *Kathāvatthu* and *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral].
Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 4,250 matching text-reuse segments across 231 Pali texts, with the heaviest concentration of shared formulas and passages found in the *Saḷāyatana Saṁyutta* (SN 35), the *Khandha Saṁyutta* (SN 22), the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 14, 15, and 16), the Vinaya *Mahākhandhaka* (Kd 1), and treatises of the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 1.1, Ps 2.10, and Ps 3.1) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, DharmaNexus establishes cross-language algorithmic alignments with Sanskrit and Tibetan Buddhist literature, including the *Mahāvastu-avadāna*, the *Saṅghabhedavastu*, the *Nidānasaṃyukta*, the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99), and Prajñāpāramitā texts [DharmaNexus].
